instruction: Retrieve the layered material MoS2 from Materials Project using mp_api. Use Pymatgen to build a bilayer MoS2 structure by stacking two monolayers along the c-axis and export it as a CIF file. Then open the CIF file in Materials Studio, select all atoms, build a surface using default parameters, and save the file to the desktop as 'MoS2.xsd'.

result.description: The XSD file is a Materials Studio structure file containing a MoS2 surface or slab model. It should be a valid XSD format and contain Mo and S atoms arranged in a layered structure.
